+// M8.1 T0 — Clerk session / bypass invariant stub (extends AuthGate story)
+module auth_session {
+
+  var sessionActive: bool
+  var bypassAllowed: bool
+  var keysConfigured: bool
+
+  action init = all {
+    sessionActive' = false,
+    bypassAllowed' = true,
+    keysConfigured' = false
+  }
+
+  action configure_keys = all {
+    keysConfigured' = true,
+    bypassAllowed' = false,
+    sessionActive' = sessionActive
+  }
+
+  action login = all {
+    keysConfigured' = keysConfigured,
+    bypassAllowed' = bypassAllowed,
+    sessionActive' = keysConfigured
+  }
+
+  // When keys configured, bypass must be false
+  val noBypassWhenConfigured = keysConfigured implies not(bypassAllowed)
+
+  action step = any {
+    configure_keys,
+    login
+  }
+}

+// M8.2 T0 — QStash at-least-once / idempotency stub
+module qstash_delivery {
+
+  var pending: int
+  var delivered: int
+  var idempotencyKeys: Set[str]
+
+  action init = all {
+    pending' = 0,
+    delivered' = 0,
+    idempotencyKeys' = Set()
+  }
+
+  action publish = all {
+    pending' = pending + 1,
+    delivered' = delivered,
+    idempotencyKeys' = idempotencyKeys
+  }
+
+  action deliver(key) = all {
+    pending' = if (pending > 0) pending - 1 else 0,
+    delivered' = if (key.in(idempotencyKeys)) delivered else delivered + 1,
+    idempotencyKeys' = idempotencyKeys.union(Set(key))
+  }
+
+  action step = any {
+    publish,
+    deliver("k1"),
+    deliver("k1")
+  }
+}
A  config/verification/quint/qstash-delivery.qnt

+---- MODULE DeployWorkflow ----
+\* M8.3 T0 — durable deploy saga stub
+EXTENDS Naturals
+
+VARIABLES stage
+
+Stages == {"Idle", "Persist", "Deploy", "Done", "Failed"}
+
+TypeOK == stage \in Stages
+
+Init == stage = "Idle"
+
+Advance ==
+  \/ /\ stage = "Idle" /\ stage' = "Persist"
+  \/ /\ stage = "Persist" /\ stage' = "Deploy"
+  \/ /\ stage = "Deploy" /\ stage' = "Done"
+  \/ /\ stage \in {"Idle", "Persist", "Deploy"} /\ stage' = "Failed"
+  \/ /\ stage \in {"Done", "Failed"} /\ UNCHANGED stage
+
+Inv == stage \in Stages
+
+Next == Advance
+Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_stage
+====
